parsed.post: Discarded latest run (1.0034). It regressed from my best (0.9865). I suspect the interaction between LR 0.04 and WD 0.1 was unstable or hit a local minimum. Next, I'll try reducing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to find a middle ground between regularization and capacity.
parsed.description: Testing an intermediate WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.05 to see if 0.1 was too aggressive for the current LR and depth configuration.
